composition_notes: Self-contained workplace conservation premise; the six status assignments, their order, binary integer coding, recurrence, modulus, and accepted checksum are explicit. The narrative does not name or hint at the qualifying participant and imposes no external-title requirement.
intended_answer: Determine the unique participant whose six listed evidence codes, iterated from x=0 by x=(17x+code) mod 101, yield the accepted checksum 69. Do not use any criterion beyond that checksum match.
premise: At the North Annex conservation workshop, a salt-stained ceramic panel is being traced after damage was found during treatment. The panel moved through the intake room, imaging room, solvent room, drying room, and documentation room. Five workshop participants—Mara, Ivo, Seline, Tomas, and Jun—left records concerning its handling. For each participant, the incident board has already adjudicated six evidence statuses, in this fixed order: relational, temporal, causal, spatial, sequence, and protocol. A status is 1 when the participant's record supports the relevant claim about the damage incident, and 0 when it does not. The adjudicated status assignments are: Mara (1,0,1,1,0,1); Ivo (0,1,1,0,1,0); Seline (1,1,0,1,1,0); Tomas (0,0,1,1,1,1); Jun (1,0,0,0,1,1). These assignments derive from the workshop's cross-room handling log, time-stamped access ledger, solvent and tool sign-out sheets, room-camera map, artifact-transfer sequence, and seal-and-signature register. The local integer coding is relational:1/0, temporal:1/0, causal:1/0, spatial:1/0, sequence:1/0, and protocol:1/0, with no other codes. To compute a candidate's docket value, start with x=0 and process the six codes in the stated order using x=(17x+code) mod 101 after each code. The incident docket's accepted checksum is 69. Within this local exercise, the term "certified restoration lead" means exactly the one participant whose six evidence statuses produce the incident's accepted iterated modular checksum under these rules. The checksum match is the sole success condition; no title, seniority, or outside credential is relevant.
setting_summary: A conservation workshop traces a damaged ceramic artifact through several rooms using handling, access, treatment, camera, sequence, and protocol records.
target_question: Which participant is the certified restoration lead under the workshop's local checksum rule?
